mapper.sql: t.*, e.actual_name AS assignee_name, (SELECT count(*) FROM sorting_task_item i WHERE i.task_id=t.id AND i.deleted=FALSE) AS item_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM sorting_task_item i WHERE i.task_id=t.id AND i.deleted=FALSE AND i.occupation_status='ACTIVE' AND i.result IS NOT NULL) AS processed_count
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sorting_task WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE

SELECT
FROM sorting_task t LEFT JOIN t_employee e ON e.employee_id=t.assignee_employee_id AND e.deleted_flag=FALSE WHERE t.deleted=FALSE AND t.status=#{q.status} AND t.warehouse_id=#{q.warehouseId} AND t.assignee_employee_id=#{q.assigneeEmployeeId} AND t.assignee_employee_id IS NULL
AND (t.task_no ILIKE concat('%',#{q.keyword},'%') OR t.warehouse_name_snapshot ILIKE concat('%',#{q.keyword},'%') OR e.actual_name ILIKE concat('%',#{q.keyword},'%') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sorting_task_item i WHERE i.task_id=t.id AND i.deleted=FALSE AND (i.order_no_snapshot ILIKE concat('%',#{q.keyword},'%') OR i.product_name_snapshot ILIKE concat('%',#{q.keyword},'%') OR i.customer_name_snapshot ILIKE concat('%',#{q.keyword},'%'))))
ORDER BY t.created_at DESC,t.id DESC

SELECT
FROM sorting_task t LEFT JOIN t_employee e ON e.employee_id=t.assignee_employee_id AND e.deleted_flag=FALSE WHERE t.id=#{id} AND t.deleted=FALSE
SELECT i.* FROM sorting_task_item i WHERE i.task_id = #{taskId} AND i.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY i.id

SELECT i.id AS sales_order_item_id, o.id AS sales_order_id, o.status AS order_status, o.deleted AS order_deleted, i.deleted AS item_deleted, o.order_no, o.customer_id, o.customer_name_snapshot AS customer_name, i.spu_id, i.sku_id, i.spu_code_snapshot, i.product_name_snapshot, i.sku_code_snapshot, i.spec_name_snapshot, i.sale_unit_snapshot, i.product_type_snapshot, i.actual_quantity FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE i.id IN #{lineId}
